optimo.html.note: App Lab prototype (optimo arc app-lab, 2026-10-14): optimo.html is the Family Wing SIGN-IN STEP only — no wing card (pages.json parent app-lab.html; the portal renders no card for a parented page), listed in App Lab via its row in app-lab/prototypes.json (upserted by optimo's release). It stays in spaces.json family so its grant key (optimo.html) and family-gate access are unchanged. The app is served at /press/app-lab/optimo/ (mirrored by optimo's web/tools/release.js into app-lab/optimo/); /press/optimo/ = a redirect tombstone. Source moved into optimo's web/ (build-press inlines the vendored family gate — deterministic, publish-checks rebuilds + compares). History: launcher card since optimo arc 2 slice 6; served from the marquee since migrate-home 2026-10-10.

cardsharp.html.note: build id = content hash of the build inputs (src-<sha256 prefix>, no git sha, no timestamp), so a rebuild at any commit with the same sources is byte-identical to cardsharp.html — docs-only commits cannot break T5. Registered 2026-09-28 (cardsharp Arc 1); content-hash id 2026-10-01 (cardsharp PR #2).

steward.html.note: press-native private-wing page (arc/steward-report, 2026-10-12): the Steward's watch/audit reports. Loads src/gate.js by relative path (like access.html); reads press_steward_reports (service-role-only) through the steward-reports Edge Function, gated on the private wing's Card Scout capability (x-plan-id). No keyring entry of its own (T7-exempt).

app-lab.html.note: App Lab — the ONE family-wing card for in-development Apple-app web prototypes (Mark, web-twin decision 6, 2026-10-13): app-lab.html lists each prototype (name · one line · status · open link) from app-lab/prototypes.json and opens it in app-lab/frame.html; each prototype is served from app-lab/<app>/ (never its own wing card) and its OWN release upserts its own prototypes.json row. A prototype that keeps a family sign-in page (optimo.html) carries pages.json parent app-lab.html so the portal shows no card for it. Vantage was the first entry (app-lab/vantage/ = the web twin's App Lab build, base /press/app-lab/vantage/, data local to the browser; added by vantage arc web-twin S8); optimo joined in optimo arc app-lab (2026-10-14).
